rung_purposes.purpose: Initialise test limits and pressure thresholds into data registers
Detect transmitter wire break if pressure drops below -500
Detect and latch pack overpressure alarm
Detect and latch supply air pressure low alarm while station is busy
Reset latched station alarms via reset pushbutton
Aggregate common station fault M299 and drive fault beacon Y25
Control manual vent valve in manual mode
Start auto test cycle when pallet arrives without active faults
Transition from clamping (M201) to filling (M202) on clamp closed feedback
Run fill timeout timer T21 during fill step
Latch fill timeout alarm M290 if fill timer expires
Transition from fill (M202) to stabilise (M203) on target pressure reach
Run pressure stabilisation timer T22
Capture initial test pressure into D110
Transition from stabilise (M203) to test (M204) when T22 expires
Run test window timer T23 during test step
Capture final pressure D111 and calculate pressure decay delta D112
Evaluate leak test decay against limit to latch PASS or FAIL
Transition from test (M204) to vent (M205) when test timer T23 expires
Abort cycle on fault: reset active steps, force vent step M205 and FAIL
Run pack vent timer T200
Transition from vent (M205) to unclamp (M206) when vented and timed out
Transition from unclamp (M206) to release (M207) on clamp open feedback
Reset station busy and step M207 when pallet exits station
Energise clamp close solenoid Y20 during clamping through venting steps
Energise fill valve Y21 during fill step if no active faults
Energise vent valve Y22 during vent step or on overpressure alarm
Output PASS (Y23) or FAIL (Y24) signals to line controller in step M207
Program execution end
